subject: Proposal: shifting from monthly billing to annual commitment — staged ramp & concessions
messages:
From: Jordan Hale <j.hale@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring annual commitment instead of monthly billing — discount & ramp questions

Hi Hannah,

We’re evaluating a move from our current month-to-month plan to an annual prepay for the platform to simplify budget and reduce costs. Before we take this to finance, we need clarity on a few items:

- If we commit to a 12-month prepay for $X/month equivalent (we’re modeling ~$180k ARR), what level of term discount do you typically provide?
- We expect usage to grow ~30% over the first 6 months; can we do a staged ramp with credits or pro-rated top-ups rather than committing to peak consumption upfront?
- Any constraints on mixing monthly overage billing with the prepaid bucket during the ramp?
- Do you provide credits for churned seats or ability to redirect unused prepay to new teams?

Appreciate a concise proposal that we can take to procurement this week.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP of Data Products
Acme Analytics

---
Attachment: current_rate_card.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hale <j.hale@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring annual commitment instead of monthly billing — discount & ramp questions

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. High level answer up front: yes, we can do a 12-month annual prepay with a staged ramp and a small set of concessions to make the economics work for both sides. Details below and I’ve looped in Marissa (sales lead on enterprise renewals) and Karthik (finance) for numbers.

Key points:
1) Term discount: for a 12-month prepaid commit at ~180k ARR we can offer a 12% term discount off list on the committed spend (applies to the prepaid bucket).
2) Staged ramp: we can structure the commitment as a time-phased schedule (months 1–3 at 60% of committed capacity, months 4–6 at 80%, months 7–12 at 100%). Any shortfall in months 1–6 would carry as credit toward the remaining term (no cash refunds).
3) Overages: monthly overage beyond the prepaid bucket will be billed at a preferential overage rate (10% above committed unit rate) rather than standard list.
4) Reassignment of unused prepay: unused prepaid credits can be redirected to other teams within Acme with a 30-day notification; churned seat protections limited to 6 months of reallocation runway.

I’m attaching a draft term sheet and a staggered ramp schedule for your review. If that looks reasonable I can send a DocuSign with the final numbers.

Quick ask: Jordan, can you confirm whether Acme needs a multi-year (2yr) price guarantee or just a single-year commitment? That affects the deepest discount we can offer.

Thanks,
Hannah
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: Redwood_proposal_annual_v2.pdf (proposal), staggered_ramp_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing posture for 180k ARR - recommended concessions

Hannah / Karthik — quick internal note before we finalize the DocuSign:

- 12% term discount at 1yr is fine but recommend a capped performance credit if usage exceeds commit by >40% (protects us from short-term spikes). Suggest an excess utilization rebate model: if monthly usage >140% of committed bucket, rebate at 15% of overage cost for that month (applies months 7–12 only).
- For staged ramp, accept the carry-forward credit approach but require quarterly true-up windows and a cap of 25% on carry-forward to avoid large backlogs.
- Allow internal reallocation across teams with a one-time admin fee ($1,000) to cover accounting.

These keep the customer happy but limit exposure. If Jordan confirms single-year only, 12% + the above protections is our standard. If they want 2-year guarantee, we can push to 18% and waive the admin fee.

-Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
